title: Cyberpunk Trio in Neon Rain
description: Three fantasy characters stand in a foggy cyberpunk street at night. On the left a dark-haired elf in purple and silver futuristic armor, in the center a tall bandaged mummy-like figure with glowing eyes, and on the right a white-haired elf in metallic armor holding a glowing object.
prompt: Three characters standing in a rainy cyberpunk city street at night, thick fog and reflections on wet ground. A dark-haired female elf in sleek purple and silver armored suit on the left, a tall wrapped mummy with one visible eye and tattered bandages in the center, and a long white-haired female elf in shiny metallic armor holding a small glowing device on the right. Neon signs with Asian characters and English text, large holographic logo in background, cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
